title: HOUSE / FIELD
purpose: Canonical public-safe HOUSE instrument: spatial addressing and projection at /house/, timestamped technical state depth at /house/expert.html, and private actuation authority in Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS.

current_surface.semantics: One addressed object, many projections. Selection and local authored state do not imply presence or actuation.

forbidden_classes: vendor device identifiers that function as credentials
enforcement: The generator builds the public document by whitelist and then scans the serialized JSON for forbidden patterns; it refuses to write on any match. The committed state.json carries its own sanitization result.
kernel_role: OBJECT -> ADDRESS -> PROJECT at canonical /house/. OPERATE remains private Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS. BODY↔HOUSE uses a local ENV-0 context envelope. RETURN is /returns/ plus receipt evidence.

spatial_state.relation: Spatial State Engine supplies ADDRESS/PROJECT semantics; Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS retains OPERATE authority.
spatial_state.thin_slice: 2D room/object graph + manual state + explicit HA entity mapping; add sensors only where they remove real friction.

body_bridge.receives: 0xxx0.body.field.latest.v01 (latest local BODY return for local display only)
body_bridge.emits: 0xxx0.house.body.context.v0.1 from canonical /house/: selected spatial address + timestamped public HOUSE projection metadata, browser-local only
body_bridge.authority: context only; selected HOUSE address is not presence or causation, does not write BODY observations into house/state.json, and grants no actuation authority
body_bridge.privacy: personal BODY state remains browser-local; no public projection includes it

reality_task_boundary.rule: Ordinary chores and personal task state are not canonical HOUSE state.
reality_task_boundary.private_execution: Route chores/maintenance obligations into browser-local Dayline or another private runtime surface.
reality_task_boundary.returns_to_house: Only durable physical/resource/state evidence returns to HOUSE (for example an adopted item, changed spatial address, verified device mapping, or completed maintenance that materially changes represented state).
reality_task_boundary.public_repo: Do not commit private chore lists, presence, schedules, or personal urgency to the public HOUSE projection.

expert_projection.generator: private normalizer in the HOUSEBUS repository (scripts/project-public.py)
expert_projection.refresh: manual: run the generator, then commit regenerated state.json
expert_projection.authority: read-only projection; never a control endpoint
